Hemorrhagic bullous lesions on the dorsal aspect of left hand extending to web space between first and second fingers
Polymerase chain reaction analysis for Erysipelothrix rhusiopathiae was negative
response.rationale: Occupational exposure and characteristic vesiculobullous hand lesions strongly suggest erysipeloid, despite negative PCR which may be false-negative; culture of Staphylococcus simulans is likely contamination rather than true pathogen.

rejected.why: Staphylococcus simulans is a common skin commensal and not a typical cause of this clinical picture; culture result likely reflects contamination, and no other staphylococcal features are present.
